input: Draft a short script for a YouTube explainer video

gold.taskTitle: Draft a YouTube Explainer Video Script
gold.taskDescription: Write a short script for a YouTube explainer video on a topic chosen by the user.

questions.title: What specific topic is the video explaining?
questions.description: Identify the exact subject or concept the explainer video will cover.

questions.title: Who is the intended audience for this video?
questions.description: Understand the target viewers, such as beginners, students, professionals, or a general audience.

questions.title: How long should the finished video be?
questions.description: Determine the target video duration, which will define the script length.

questions.title: What tone should the script use?
questions.description: Clarify whether the tone should be formal, conversational, humorous, educational, or something else.

questions.title: What is the single key takeaway for viewers?
questions.description: Identify the one main message or action the audience should walk away with.

questions.title: Will a real person appear on camera or use voiceover?
questions.description: Understand the delivery format to tailor the script style and pacing appropriately.

questions.title: Does the script need a call to action at the end?
questions.description: Find out if the video should prompt viewers to subscribe, visit a link, buy something, or take any other specific step.
